messages:
alex: Hey team, onboarding snag: HR created my account with alias alex.j@redwood.com but the 1Password invite went to alex@personalmail.com. I can't find the invite to accept. Any advice?

janet_it: Hi @alex, we usually send invites to the corporate alias. Did HR put your personal as primary? Can you paste the invite email headers or just confirm both addresses?

alex: HR used my personal as primary during intake. I can ask them to swap but wanted a faster workaround since I need CLI access for a sandbox.

sebastian: Quick workaround: 1Password supports guest invites and account recovery. @janet_it can resend to corporate alias or issue a temporary guest. Also confirm your Google/Okta identity is tied to the corporate alias so SSO works.

1password-bot: If an invite was sent to alex@personalmail.com, it will expire after 7 days. Admins can reissue. For CLI: you need org invite accepted in browser to get the Secret Key for `op signin`.

janet_it: I've asked HR to flip primary to alex.j@redwood.com. In the meantime I can issue a one-time guest invite to your personal address for immediate CLI setup if you need it now. Do you want that?

alex: Yes please, that would be awesome. Also I tried enrolling MFA via Okta but SMS failed because my phone is an international number (+44). Okta kept rejecting the OTP send.

sebastian: For international numbers we sometimes block SMS by default due to cost. We prefer passkeys or authenticator apps. Can you use Google Authenticator or register a passkey from your phone?

alex: I can do passkey on iPhone. Will that let me access the 1Password web flow if I accept the guest invite?

1password-bot: Yes. Guest invite + passkey enrollment works for Okta web SSO. After you accept the invite in a browser and set up passkey, you can `op signin` and enable CLI. Secret Key will be in the browser setup page.

janet_it: Guest invite sent to alex@personalmail.com (expires in 48h). HR flipped primary to alex.j@redwood.com; I scheduled a canonical invite for that address, will send once provisioning completes.

alex: Guest invite accepted, passkey enrolled, and CLI signin succeeded. Thanks! Quick note: can we add a step in the onboarding checklist to confirm which email is primary before sending 1Password invites? Saved me a half-hour.

sebastian: Good idea. Please drop a short blurb in the onboarding doc and tag IT. I'll update the international SMS note to recommend passkeys or authenticators for hires outside the US.

alex: Done, PR at https://redwood.internal/docs/handbook/pull/459. Appreciate the quick help.

help-bot: onboarding-checklist: reminder queued to review "primary email assignment" item (task id: ob-327).
